text: Wera Werkzeuge, the Wuppertal screwing-tools maker, was taken over by Bitburger Holding in 2016; the Simon entrepreneur family behind Bitburger acts as Wera's shareholder. Bitburger Holding lists Wera as a majority share in its portfolio.
short: Wera is majority-owned by Bitburger Holding (Simon family) since 2016.

source.name: kfz-betrieb (Vogel): 'Bitburger Holding kauft Werkzeughersteller Wera'
source.quote: Die Bitburger Holding übernimmt im Herbst den Wuppertaler Werkzeughersteller Wera. Wie der Werkzeugspezialist mitteilte, wird künftig die Unternehmerfamilie Simon, die hinter Bitburger steht, als Gesellschafter von Wera auftreten
source.note: Bitburger Holding is taking over the Wuppertal tool maker Wera in the autumn; in future the Simon entrepreneur family behind Bitburger will act as Wera's shareholder - provided the Federal Cartel Office approves the takeover.

additionalSources.name: Bitburger Holding: Our Shareholdings
additionalSources.quote: Bitburger Holding currently holds stakes in five successful companies with long-term prospects.
additionalSources.note: The page presents each holding by logo: the 'Tools' entry shows the Wera logo linking to www-de.wera.de, described as development and production of screwing tools, and captioned 'Majority share'.
